answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 1881 Country: Pakistan Title: Can we perform Umra by wearing Ihram from Masjid Ayesh in Macca for the 2nd Umra? Question: Can we perform Umra by wearing Ihram from Masjid Ayesh in Macca for the 2nd Umra? Answer ID: 1881 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 693/689=N) Yes, you can perform umrah by wearing ihram from Masjid-e-Ayesha and generally people wear ihram on this place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
